verdict.rationale: Groq's docs and community evidence confirm a serverless multi-model catalog including GPT-OSS 120B, Llama variants, Mixtral, and Kimi K2, all served over an OpenAI-compatible endpoint with per-model pricing/rate-limit tables (groq-docs-3, groq-docs-38, groq-comm-2, groq-comm-14). However, the evidence pack never names Qwen or DeepSeek specifically, so the 'broad catalog spanning these named families' claim is only partially substantiated. missing for 10: explicit documentation of Qwen and DeepSeek availability, a full current model list showing breadth across all named families.
